measure.measure_definition: Measured value: fatigue T score (EORTC CAT Core), with higher scores indicating greater fatigue burden.; Participants; EORTC CAT Core short forms from the QLQ-C30 completed via a smartphone application; scores standardized as T scores against the European general population (mean [SD], 50 [10]). result.statistical_method: Linear mixed-effects model for six-month fatigue, with a random intercept for study center, adjusted for baseline PRO score, stratification factors, age, ECOG status, systemic therapy, sociodemographic factors, comorbidity index scores, depression, and enrollment period; two-sided primary-outcome test. Missing survivor data handled by chained-equation multiple imputation within randomized arm (m = 30). Patients who died before month 6 received the highest fatigue score in their arm.
